bullets: • Validate HTML/CSS syntax with linter before submission; catch malformed markup early.
• Verify all `<style>` tags properly closed; never nest or leave unclosed blocks.
• Confirm HTML selectors exist in markup before writing CSS rules; read target file.
• Remove duplicate CSS selectors and conflicting rules; patch property values in place.
• Check `-webkit-text-fill-color` and `background-clip:text` conflicts; remove or override before setting color.
• Use hex color format exclusively; never mix rgb() and hex for identical colors.
• Update deployment metadata (version, timestamp, changelog) for every patch submission.
• Maintain test coverage; verify all changes pass linting and automated tests before merge.
